summary: Before an Exe workspace update streams the image, `exeRollout.sh update` now checks the guest disk. It makes sure the disk is at least `EXE_WORKSPACE_DISK_GB` (100 GB by default) with room for twice the image plus 5 GiB, and grows it with `exe.dev resize` when needed. If the space still does not appear, it stops before the transfer; after the new container is ready, it removes older `halo-workspace` images, and new templates use the same 100 GB default. The sizing arithmetic, error exits, pause restore, and non-fatal cleanup are correct, the temp test covers the no-resize, grow-to-default, grow-by-shortfall, and no-room-after-resize paths, and all tests pass.
